features.title: Consent and preference widgets
deliverables: Compact nonmodal bottom notice by default on mobile; clear permission request with balanced accept/reject/customize actions.

features.title: Service gating and withdrawal
deliverables: Declared service loaders and teardown hooks; inert scripts, images, and embeds until allowed.
Separate device-access permission from downstream processing restrictions.
Stop future work, remove accessible declared storage, and surface vendor/reload limitations after withdrawal.

features.title: Preference lifetime and revisions
deliverables: Purpose-level persisted choices, scope compatibility, expiry, and cross-tab updates.
Separate prompt suppression, grant expiry, evidence retention, and document versions.
Never convert dismissal, malformed state, missing storage, or stale scope into permission.

features.title: Collection notices and form permissions
deliverables: Inline collection notice, optional permission field/group, notice link, and explicit terms action.
Purpose/channel-specific choices and versioned form text; no forced privacy-policy acceptance checkbox.

features.title: Durable evidence with notabenda-cf
deliverables: Transactional Durable Object records, artifact registration, anonymous receipts, and authenticated subject events; alternative storage adapters later.
Export, controlled erasure, retention cleanup, access controls, and evidence provenance.
Separate browser-reported actions from trusted application events; configurable transport for existing backends.

features.title: Regional requirement profiles

deliverables: Configurable rights/contact page and links for access, correction, erasure, withdrawal, and applicable appeals.
